policy: Every shipped 3D asset needs an entry whose sha256 matches the file. Component status: 'project' (authored or generated by this repository), 'verified' (licence evidence recorded and reviewed), 'unresolved' (licence not established). Release builds (npm run check:assets -- --release) fail on any 'unresolved' component. See docs/ASSET_LICENCE_RESOLUTION.md.
